text: 中信建投发布黄金2027年投资展望称，2026年压制金价的核心矛盾来自实际利率上行，展望2027年，实际利率进一步上行空间有限，叠加本轮加息预期已被市场充分定价，同时全球央行持续购金将在金价回调阶段形成承接、构筑底部支撑，预期2027年金价有望震荡上行。风险方面，美伊地缘冲突推升油价，进而扰动通胀仍是2027年主要风险变量，但预期该因素对金价的冲击力度预计边际减弱。黄金股方面，2026年行业安全整治带来产量阶段性承压，2027年预计停产矿山陆续复产，产量有望迎来修复释放，当前板块估值安全边际充足，若金价中枢抬升，黄金板块有望迎来业绩与估值的双击行情，建议
text_en: CSC released its 2027 gold investment outlook, stating that the core contradiction suppressing gold prices in 2026 came from rising real interest rates. Looking ahead to 2027, the room for further increases in real interest rates is limited, and combined with the fact that this round of rate-hike expectations has been fully priced in by the market, continued gold purchases by global central banks will provide absorption and bottom support during gold price corrections. Gold prices are expected to trend upward with volatility in 2027. On risks, the US-Iran geopolitical conflict pushing up oil prices and thereby disrupting inflation remains the main risk variable for 2027, but the impact of this factor on gold prices is expected to diminish marginally. On gold equities, industry safety rectification in 2026 will put phased pressure on output, and suspended mines are expected to resume production gradually in 2027, with output expected to recover and be released.
